$comment: Deploy inputs wrangler.jsonc cannot hold, read by scripts/release/manifest-lib.ts (the release manifest, ADR 0160) and scripts/deploy.mjs. `features.ai`: Workers AI and Vectorize, remote-only so left out of wrangler.jsonc (ADR 0156); turned off with ROS_AI=off or `create-relationship-os --ai off`. `vectorize`: how each index is created. `aiGateway`: the AI Gateway installs create with AI on (ADR 0180): its settings (authentication is always on) and the custom providers to create, called as custom-<slug> (`typesafe` ships for the judge, ADR 0230; built-in gateway providers such as deepseek need none, ADR 0192). `secrets`: optional secrets beyond package.json's. Values are never committed.

customProviders.name: TypeSafe AI (Jev)
customProviders.description: The judge (ADR 0230): Jev's typed decisions at /v1/systemone. Inert without a key: BYOK with --provider-key typesafe=…, or the TYPESAFE_API_KEY secret.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Settings → AI's Cloudflare API token: provider keys as Workers secrets, AI Gateway usage (docs/deploying.md, In-app AI). Set from ROS_AI_ADMIN_TOKEN.

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN
secrets.description: The AI Gateway token (an account token with AI Gateway Run and Workers AI Read), sent as cf-aig-authorization, and for Workers AI over REST through the gateway with payload logging off. Generated by the installer and the updater (ADR 0180, ADR 0330).
